description: This file implements jQuery color animation functionalities, including color parsing, conversion between color spaces, color blending, and CSS hooks for animated color transitions.

classes.name: jQuery.Color
classes.description: A class providing color parsing, representation, and conversion methods.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses various color representations (string, array, object) into internal color format.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the current color matches another color.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Interpolates between colors based on a specified distance.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Blends the current color with another to produce an opaque color.

methods.name: toRgbaString
methods.description: Returns the CSS rgba() string representation.

methods.name: toHslaString
methods.description: Returns the CSS hsla() string representation.

methods.name: toHexString
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal color string, optionally including alpha.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the color, defaulting to rgba.
